newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SE signs SKK 5.3 bln deal for plant upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SE signs SKK 5.3 bln deal for plant upgrade.

text.p: Slovak state monopoly electrical utility Slovenske Elektrarne a.s. (SE) on Wednesday signed a 5.3 billion crown deal with Slovenske Energeticke Strojarne a.s. (SES) to upgrade its Vojany thermal power plant.
The contract is for the complete turnkey reconstruction of two 110 MW blocks at the Vojany plant in eastern Slovakia.

The project envisages the complete replacement of obsolete blocks five and six and their replacement with circulating fluid coal combustion furnaces, steam turbines with generators, a water condensation and regeneration system.
SES was awarded the contract after a public tender which included 14 international bidders.

Part of the project is financed by the European Investment Bank with which SE last November signed a 130 million ECU 15-year framework loan agreement covering half of the total costs of upgrading Vojany.
On Monday SE signed a further 70 million ECU, five-year revolving credit lead-managed by Bank of America and Sumitomo Bank.
Earlier on Wednesday Austrian Energy, a unit of VA Technologie said it had won two contracts worth ATS 370 million from SE for the environmental upgrading of part of the Vojany plant.
